title: Base32 Codec
description: Encode UTF-8 text or hex bytes and decode RFC 4648 Base32 or Base32hex. Defaults: alphabet base32, padding true, inputEncoding utf8. Decoding is case-sensitive, rejects whitespace, malformed padding and nonzero unused bits; padding false requires no equals signs. Returns valid, operation, alphabet, encoded (canonical), hex, text (null for invalid UTF-8), and byteLength. UTF-8 encoding replaces lone surrogates with U+FFFD. Limits: 100000 input characters. Errors return valid:false, error, message.

inputEncoding.description: Encoding of data for encode; ignored for decode.
